name: detach-and-redock-round-trips
description:
undock DevTools into its own window and dock it back, twice over, with the pane slot emptying and refilling each time.

Two independent readings, because either alone can lie. The window COUNT proves a separate window really appeared - a detach that only re-laid-out the pane would not change it. The pane's own dock-state line proves the slot emptied - a window opening beside a still-docked pane would not.

Repeated rather than done once: a round trip that works the first time and leaks on the second is the failure this criterion is written against.

actions.note: let the space and its single tab render
ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot; without this the keystroke lands in Finder (traffic-routing learned this the hard way)
open DevTools on the active tab
DevTools frontend is a full WebContents load - generous on purpose, the dock VLOG only fires once UpdateDockedDevtoolsForPane runs with a non-null GetInTabWebContents
arming read: every result below is worthless if the frontend never answered

actions.expression: (() => { const find = (root, depth) => { if (depth > 10) return null; for (const el of root.querySelectorAll('*')) {   if (el.shadowRoot) { const h = find(el.shadowRoot, depth + 1); if (h) return h; }   const l = (el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute('aria-label')) || '';   if (/^customize and control/i.test(l.trim())) return el; } return null; }; const item = find(document, 0); if (!item) return 'not offered'; item.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

assertions.note: the undock item was offered and pressed
and so was the re-dock, which means the menu survived the detach

assertions.label: the-slot-emptied-on-detach
assertions.note: docked=0 is the pane reporting its slot empty. Without this a detach that merely opened a window beside a still-docked pane would pass.

assertions.label: and-refilled-after-the-detach
assertions.note: A re-dock is a docked=1 line that appears AFTER the docked=0 one. Counting totals was the wrong instrument: this run legitimately produces several dock transitions, so any ceiling either admits a per-paint emitter or rejects honest relayouts. Ordering states the actual claim - the slot emptied, then it refilled.
